items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Well, Luis the man taught him. He had his own band.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know what I heard of him? Somewhere. Who else did he play with?
Well, Luis the man taught him. He had his own band. He died in California somewhere.

Is that the guy that played with Jack Carey? Yeah, he played with a lot of those things. He did. He would play with the writing bands, going there? Yeah. Yeah. What about your father? Did he play music? No, nobody in the family played music at that time. Did they sing? Well yeah, but there's church members,
